objective: Implement candidate-independent, digest-pinned GitHub provider policy evaluation and a bounded authenticated single-operator grant verifier for offline reference flows. Keep effect authorization blocked until durable replay/revocation and target enforcement exist.
nonGoals: No independent release signing/publication, no credential generation, no destination writes
No granting an effect merely because CI is green, a grant MAC matches, or a candidate supplies a policy digest
No assumption HMAC is fit for multi-operator/public verifier systems; no hardcoded production secret
decisions: Reuse provider query/strict validation in sf.ci_evidence but take CI request only from a digest-pinned external policy, not the candidate.
Use standard-library HMAC-SHA256 as single-operator reference-grant authentication only. Public-key provider and durable replay store are pending; output must not imply release authority.

obligations.description: Hash-pin canonical externally held CI request, reject substitutions and propagate provider missing/skipped/cancelled failures.
Verify MAC over canonical strict grant, expiry, exact effect, target, artifact and policy bindings, with no effect rights.
No release/deployment effect claim until independently protected key and nonce ledger, real provider proof, target credential and effect checks.

structure: src/sf/release_authority.py: pinned CI authority observation and offline authenticated grant verifier
tests/test_release_authority.py: negative grant and policy tests
docs/factory/evidence/PQ-02.md: gaps and lack of live verification
impact: New opt-in pure APIs; no mutation of existing SF10 or SF14 semantics

budget.network: No external provider queries from tests; real query only when caller supplies independently pinned request
budget.execution: One hosted stable-candidate run; no extra push triggers

externalEffects: Stack only over PR #33; do not merge until PR #38 checkpoint
No credentials, live publication, or adopter mutations
